0022600176.text: The Hornets (3-5, 9th in the East) visit the Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 14th in the East) with Charlotte on a four-game losing streak, while Brooklyn has lost its last six. Charlotte is without Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, who are both out with hamstring injuries, and Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 110-103 win in Brooklyn on October 21, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
